title: Tutoring Intake Request Form
subtitle: Capture learner goal, source work, session schedule, and support need; confirm tutor match and progress checkpoint.
description: Tutoring Intake records learner goal, source work, session schedule, support need, tutor match, and progress checkpoint. Tutoring Intake evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this tutoring intake request intake when staff must document learner goal and source work. Reconcile session schedule, support need, tutor match, and progress checkpoint before the tutoring intake handoff. Use the intake request, learner work sample, teacher referral if provided, availability calendar, tutor-match rationale, support-route acknowledgment, and first-session plan. For tutoring intake live use, check roster. Reconcile the tutoring intake schedule and actual handoff times. Preserve the tutoring intake roster and schedule. Record the tutoring intake handoff time and instructions. Close the tutoring intake exception queue. Verify tutoring intake day-of-service timing. Resolve tutoring intake real-time changes and operating handoff for tutoring intake. Ask the assigned tutoring intake reviewer to confirm learner goal against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Tutoring Intake requester details review
sections.guidance: Preserve learner goal, source assignment or assessment, preferred schedule, support need, tutor match factors, session plan, and initial progress checkpoint.

sections.title: Tutoring Intake exception review and request scope
sections.guidance: Separate the requested outcome from constraints and optional items.

blocks.label: Tutoring Intake request checks
items: Learner goal is identified for this record
Source work matches the current request or source
Session schedule is ready for point-of-use staff
Support need limits or questions are resolved

sections.title: Tutoring Intake exception review and response
sections.guidance: Record the authorized response without promising an unapproved outcome.
